author: Tumseneho
title: Annoying
content:
The game it self is a puzzle challenge. it takes about a minute to solve each step, but in between level play is 5 to 10 minutes of the most annoying “Do not accept a NO” advertisements. I am deleting the game because the ads are so overwhelming. 
The “CLAIM 2” requires you watching an advertisement for so long, then when it finally completes, the balance was not rewarded. The special play assistant icon is positioned so close to the puzzle activity, it gets touched by accident, and you just used an assist on something worthless. The app also inserts fully locked rings that cannot be broken without use of an assist forcing your hand to purposely force the advertising. Never been so annoyed by the app being issued this way. So long app writers. I’m out 
Signed “LEO”
